title: LinkedIn Company Profile Scraper Input

companyUrls.title: LinkedIn companies
companyUrls.description: One or more public LinkedIn company pages to scrape. Each item is either a full URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe) or just the vanity name (e.g. stripe). University /school/ and /showcase/ pages are not supported. Not a LinkedIn person profile - for people use the linkedin-profile-details-scraper actor.

maxCompanies.title: Maximum companies
maxCompanies.description: Maximum number of company profiles to scrape and bill in this run. Accepts 1 to 1000; defaults to 100. Extra input URLs beyond this cap are ignored. Caps your spend at maxCompanies x the per-company price.

includeSimilarCompanies.title: Include similar companies
includeSimilarCompanies.description: Attach the 'similar / also viewed' company pages LinkedIn lists on the profile (name, url, industry). Defaults to true. Set false for a leaner record. Does not add a separate charge.

includeEmployeesSample.title: Include sample employees
includeEmployeesSample.description: Attach a small public sample of employees surfaced on the company page (name, title, profile URL, image). Defaults to false. This is a preview sample, not the full employee roster - for that use the linkedin-company-employee-scraper actor.

maxEmployeesSample.title: Max sample employees
maxEmployeesSample.description: How many sample employees to include when 'Include sample employees' is on. Accepts 1 to 100; defaults to 10. Ignored when the sample is disabled.

includeRawData.title: Include raw response data
includeRawData.description: Add the compact raw provider payload under rawData for debugging or custom parsing. Defaults to false. Increases record size noticeably; leave off for normal use.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
